item.title: funky
item.description:
website

I download vs code. vs code is used to write markdown. I also download the Quarto extension for vs code. Quarto is used to render markdown into a website. I also download the GitHub extension for vs code. GitHub is used to store my website and make it public. my website quarto website project is called “jiahe-site”. The GitHub pages extension is used to deploy my website to GitHub pages. I use github actions to publish my website.

today

i plan to make game hehe. mini game sry. i collaborate with copilot agent. but copilot do all the work. i just tell copilot what to do. but i actually don’t do anything. I dont know what game.

copilot give me suggest 1. Donut Catcher
Move a plate left and right to catch falling donuts. Miss three and the game ends. Add faster falling speed and a high-score counter.

  1. Code Breaker
    Guess a secret four-digit code. The game tells you how many digits are correct and in the right position, like Mastermind.

  2. Bike Trail Dash
    Control a cyclist, avoid rocks, collect water bottles, and survive as long as possible. The score increases with distance.

  3. Memory Flip
    Flip cards to match pairs of icons, such as bikes, books, laptops, and donuts. Add a timer and a move counter.

  4. Build-a-Website Puzzle
    Click items in the correct order: write Markdown, add CSS, render with Quarto, then deploy with GitHub Actions. Wrong choices reset the level.

item.title: Project kickoff
item.description:
What I did

Cloned the family repo and opened my Quarto site with quarto preview.

What I learned

  • Markdown is how I write; Quarto is how it becomes a website
  • AI tools work best when I describe clearly what I want

Tomorrow

Pick a Quarto theme in _quarto.yml that feels like me.

Markdown practice

Here’s a table I made by hand:

Tool Best for
Cursor Big edits, asking questions
Copilot Suggestions while typing
Claude Code Terminal scripts

My rule: I write the journal; AI helps me polish — not invent my day.
